channel.title: BC Arts Grants Weekly Updates
channel.description: New and approaching funding opportunities for artists, arts organizations, and eligible community arts projects in British Columbia.

item.title: Individual Arts Grants: Visual Artists — BC Arts Council
item.description: Open through November 25, 2026 at 11:59 p.m. PT. Up to $15,000 supports established B.C. visual and craft artists, and independent visual or media arts critics and curators, with research and creation projects. New applicants must register by November 18.

item.title: Video Games Early Stage Growth — Creative BC
item.description: Open through November 2, 2026 at 4:00 p.m. PT. Grants of up to $50,000 support eligible early-stage B.C.-based video game studios with business growth and long-term market development.

item.title: Youth Forums Canada — Canadian Heritage
item.description: Open through November 2, 2026 at 4:00 p.m. ET. Funding generally ranges from $20,000 to $200,000 for eligible organizations delivering national or interprovincial in-person youth forums, including qualifying arts and culture programs.

item.title: Short-Term Projects — Creating, Knowing and Sharing
item.description: Open through November 25, 2026. Canada Council project funding supports eligible First Nations, Inuit and Métis artists, groups and organizations undertaking artistic and cultural activities lasting up to one year.

item.title: 2027 Festival Project Grant — City of Victoria
item.description: Open through December 1, 2026 at 11:59 p.m. Grants of up to $40,000 support eligible non-profit organizations delivering recurring arts and cultural festivals or celebrations in Victoria during 2027.

item.title: 2027 Cultural Infrastructure Grant — City of Victoria
item.description: Open through December 18, 2026 at 11:59 p.m. Category maximums range from $15,000 to $250,000 for eligible Victoria arts and culture non-profits creating or improving cultural spaces, accessibility, equipment or project plans.

item.title: Community Cultural Action Fund — Canadian Heritage
item.description: Supports cultural, artistic and heritage participation in official-language minority communities. B.C. regional organizations submit a letter of intent by February 1, 2027 and a full application by April 6; eligible national organizations apply by November 15, 2026.

item.title: Heritage Vitality Program — First Peoples' Cultural Council
item.description: Open through November 25, 2026 at 4:30 p.m. PT. Grants of $20,000–$100,000 support eligible B.C. First Nations governments and First Nations-led organizations with cultural practices, heritage stewardship, and braided arts-and-heritage infrastructure.

item.title: Celebrate Canada 2027 — Canadian Heritage
item.description: Open through November 23, 2026 at 4:00 p.m. ET. Grants of up to $50,000 support eligible Canadian organizations presenting free public celebrations from June 21 to July 1, 2027; entertainment and artist fees can be eligible.

item.title: Multiculturalism and Anti-Racism Program — Events
item.description: Open through October 27, 2026. Up to $100,000 per event supports eligible public community events promoting intercultural understanding, diversity or anti-racism; qualifying artistic performances, workshops and artist fees may be included.

item.title: Multiculturalism and Anti-Racism Program — Anti-Racism Call
item.description: Open through November 12, 2026. Eligible projects addressing systemic racism usually request up to $300,000, with an absolute maximum of $1 million. Arts-based approaches can qualify when they directly advance the call's anti-racism outcomes.

item.title: Aid to Publishers — Magazine
item.description: Open through November 12, 2026 at 4:00 p.m. ET. The Canada Periodical Fund provides up to $1.5 million for eligible Canadian print-magazine publishers, including support for writing, editing, photography, illustration and design.

item.title: Aid to Publishers — Digital Periodical
item.description: Open through November 12, 2026 at 4:00 p.m. ET. The Canada Periodical Fund provides up to $1.5 million for eligible Canadian digital-only periodical publishers, including support for writing, editing, photography, illustration and design.

item.title: Project Assistance: Professional Arts Festivals — BC Arts Council
item.description: Open through November 19, 2026. Grants of up to $25,000 support eligible B.C. arts organizations and arts or curatorial collectives developing public programming within an established multi-day professional arts festival. First-time, single-day and community arts festivals are not eligible for this program.

item.title: Project Development Fund — Creative BC
item.description: Open on a first-come, first-served basis until the 2026–27 budget is committed, no later than March 31, 2027. Provides non-recoupable advances matching up to 50% of an eligible triggering-agent development commitment for B.C.-owned and controlled production companies developing feature films, dramatic or animated television projects, or documentaries. Applications must be submitted within 60 days of the triggering commitment.

item.title: Passport to Markets — Asia TV Forum & Market — Creative BC
item.description: Closed: the Asia TV Forum & Market application deadline was September 30, 2026. The broader Passport to Markets program continues to list future market-specific intakes.

item.title: Domestic Industry Initiatives — Creative BC
item.description: Rolling intake until March 1, 2027 at 4:00 p.m. PST, or until funds are exhausted. Grants start at $1,000 and may cover up to 75% of eligible project costs. This intake is restricted to eligible B.C. creative-industry organizations that received DII funding in 2024–25 and/or 2025–26, for continuing or previously approved projects.

item.title: Neighbourhood Small Grants — Vancouver Foundation
item.description: Grants of $50 to $500 support resident-led ideas that connect neighbours. Community arts activities, creative workshops, book exchanges and other accessible local gatherings may qualify. Availability and exact deadlines vary by community, so applicants should check their location on the official program website.

item.title: Arts Infrastructure Program — BC Arts Council
item.description: Now open; deadline November 12, 2026. Eligible B.C. arts and cultural organizations may request up to $25,000 for planning and consultation, $250,000 for capital improvements, or $40,000 for specialized equipment supporting arts and cultural spaces.

item.title: Indigenous Arts Program Pilot — Indigenous-Led Organizations & Collectives
item.description: Now open; deadline November 12, 2026. This separate stream supports eligible Indigenous-led organizations and Indigenous collectives in B.C. that lead artistic and cultural activities. Funding streams range from micro grants up to $5,000 to large-scale grants up to $25,000.

item.title: Participatory Action Research Grants — Vancouver Foundation
item.description: Closed: the application deadline was October 13, 2026 at 5 p.m. PT. Convene grants offered up to $25,000 and Investigate grants up to $100,000 per year for three years for eligible community and research partnerships addressing defined health outcomes.

item.title: Indigenous Communities Fund — TELUS
item.description: Closed: both 2026 application intakes have ended. Grants of $5,000 to $25,000 supported eligible Indigenous-led community initiatives across Canada, including language and cultural revitalization, cultural knowledge and community connection.

item.title: Indigenous Arts Program Pilot — Individuals, Groups & Collaborations
item.description: Now open; deadline November 12, 2026. First Nations, Inuit and Métis artists, cultural practitioners, Knowledge Keepers, Knowledge Holders and Culture Carriers in B.C. may apply as individuals or on behalf of an ad hoc group or collaboration. Funding streams range from micro grants up to $5,000 to large-scale grants up to $25,000.

item.title: Cultural Operating Funding — City of Vancouver
item.description: Now open; deadline November 4, 2026 at 11:59 p.m. Provides core operating support to eligible established Vancouver-based professional non-profit arts and cultural organizations. New applicants must have completed the 2026 expression-of-interest process.

item.title: Application Assistance — BC Arts Council
item.description: Ongoing. Helps Deaf or disabled artists and arts practitioners cover eligible costs related to BC Arts Council grant applications, updates and final reports.

item.title: Access Support — BC Arts Council
item.description: Ongoing. Additional accessibility support that must be requested with, or after approval of, an associated BC Arts Council grant.

item.title: Representation and Promotion — Canada Council for the Arts
item.description: Ongoing before departure. Supports travel linked to promoting Canadian artists and artistic works and developing markets.

item.title: Foreign Artist Tours — Canada Council for the Arts
item.description: Deadline: November 4, 2026. Supports international artist tours or exhibitions presented to audiences in Canada.

item.title: Operating Assistance: Literary Arts — BC Arts Council
item.description: Closed: the application deadline was October 8, 2026. Operating support for eligible established B.C. non-profit literary arts organizations and arts periodical publishers.

item.title: Operating Assistance: Professional Arts Training Organizations
item.description: Closed: the application deadline was October 8, 2026. Supports established B.C. non-profit organizations providing specialized professional arts training.

item.title: Operating Assistance: Arts & Cultural Service Organizations
item.description: Closed: the application deadline was October 8, 2026. Supports eligible B.C. arts and cultural service organizations with an established membership base and provincial impact.

item.title: Operating Assistance: Book Publishers — BC Arts Council
item.description: Closed: the application deadline was October 8, 2026. Operating support for eligible B.C. book publishers developing and promoting Canadian writers.

item.title: Project Assistance: Community Arts Organizations
item.description: Closed: the application deadline was October 14, 2026. The program supported eligible B.C. community arts councils and cultural organizations with specific projects or production activities.

item.title: Project Assistance: Media Arts Organizations
item.description: Closed: the application deadline was October 14, 2026. The program supported independent media arts works, programming and community-engagement initiatives.

item.title: Project Assistance: Museums and Indigenous Cultural Centres
item.description: Closed: the application deadline was October 14, 2026. The program supported exhibitions, public programs, residencies, collections work and community engagement.

item.title: Project Assistance: Visual Arts Organizations
item.description: Closed: the application deadline was October 14, 2026. The program supported new or expanded public programming and community engagement in visual arts and craft.

item.title: Local Festivals — Building Communities Through Arts and Heritage
item.description: Closed: the October 15, 2026 application deadline has passed. The program offered up to $200,000 for eligible recurring local festivals presenting local arts, heritage and Indigenous cultural activities.

item.title: Professional Arts Festivals and Performing Arts Series Presenters — Canada Arts Presentation Fund
item.description: Closed: the October 15, 2026 application deadline has passed. The program supported eligible professional arts festivals and performing arts series presenters across Canada, including B.C. organizations.

item.title: Support for Organizations — Canada Book Fund
item.description: Now open; deadline October 31, 2026 at 4:00 p.m. ET. Supports eligible Canadian book-industry organizations with marketing, professional development, internships and technology projects.

item.title: Indigenous Heritage — Museums Assistance Program
item.description: Deadline: November 2, 2026. Supports the preservation, management and presentation of Indigenous cultural heritage.

item.title: Access to Heritage — Museums Assistance Program
item.description: Deadline: November 2, 2026. Supports travelling exhibitions that help heritage organizations reach audiences across Canada.

item.title: Collections Management — Museums Assistance Program
item.description: Deadline: November 2, 2026. Supports professional knowledge, skills and practices for museum collections management.

item.title: Endowment Incentives — Canada Cultural Investment Fund
item.description: Deadline: December 1, 2026. Government matching support for eligible private donations raised for professional arts organizations’ endowment funds.

item.title: Canada Cultural Spaces Fund — Canadian Heritage
item.description: Ongoing while funds remain available. Supports eligible renovations and specialized equipment for arts, heritage and cultural spaces.

item.title: Development — Canada Arts Presentation Fund
item.description: Contact the regional office for the deadline. Supports emerging arts presenters serving under-served communities or artistic practices.

item.title: Exhibition Circulation Fund — Museums Assistance Program
item.description: Ongoing intake. Helps eligible museums host travelling exhibitions or borrow artefacts from federal institutions; available funding is limited.

item.title: Community Climate Action Grant — City of Vancouver
item.description: Expression of Interest stage closed October 1, 2026. Only invited applicants will proceed to the full application due November 26, 2026.

item.title: 2027 Cultural Grants — City of Surrey
item.description: Closed: the application deadline was October 5, 2026. Open support for Surrey arts, culture and heritage through celebration, project and operating categories.

item.title: 2027 Culture Project Grant — City of Nanaimo
item.description: Closed: the application deadline was October 6, 2026. Supports culture and heritage projects contributing to Nanaimo’s cultural, social and economic vitality.

item.title: 2027 Culture Operating Grant — City of Nanaimo
item.description: Closed: the application deadline was October 6, 2026. Annual operating support for qualifying professional arts, culture and heritage non-profits in Nanaimo.

item.title: Individual Arts Grants: Creative Writers — BC Arts Council
item.description: Closed: the application deadline was October 8, 2026. Project support for professional B.C. writers undertaking specific creative writing projects.

item.title: Circulation and Touring — Canada Council for the Arts
item.description: Closed: the application deadline was October 7, 2026. Supports circulation and touring of Canadian artists, exhibitions and artistic works.

item.title: Accelerate Program — BC Arts Council
item.description: Closed: the application deadline was October 8, 2026. A two-year initiative to improve access and reduce funding barriers for equity-deserving and regional arts groups.

item.title: Operating Assistance: Community Arts Organizations
item.description: Closed: the application deadline was October 8, 2026. Operating support for organizations providing public access to arts and culture and developing community leadership.

item.title: Operating Assistance: Museums & Indigenous Cultural Centres
item.description: Closed: the application deadline was October 8, 2026. Supports annual public, curatorial and collections programs of eligible museums and Indigenous cultural centres.

item.title: Operating Assistance: Visual & Media Arts Organizations
item.description: Closed: the application deadline was October 8, 2026. Operating support for sustained public, artistic and curatorial programs in visual and media arts.
